services.name: CrossFit Kids
services.desc: Classes are held in a group setting. They are primarily game based, incorporating skill work and weighted movements that translate directly into what kids do every day in play: running, jumping, climbing, throwing, pushing and pulling. A typical class usually starts with a warm up, moves into skill work, a workout, and finishes with a game. CrossFit Kids’ primary goal is to equate fitness with fun, thereby placing fitness as a priority in life. CrossFit Kids is a program that was introduced in 2004 to provide strength and conditioning to children while meeting their developmental needs physically, neurologically and cognitively as well.
